# ATLAS Repository Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` before material work. ATLAS uses the XYRA process: `Ø → Manus → GitHub → Traycer → CodeSpring → Gauntlet → Release`.

For scoped implementation, read the assigned issue/work package and its `context_manifest`; use `docs/CONTEXT_INDEX.md` to locate governing documents. Do not recursively ingest the full CodeSpring Markdown corpus.

Authority: direct Ø instruction > `BUILD_CONTRACT.md` > PRD/architecture/data/API specs > accepted ADRs > scoped issue/acceptance criteria > project memory/tool role docs > supporting corpus.

Preserve: global-by-default capital routing; founder sovereignty; organic ranking independence from payment; evidence/provenance; deterministic scoring/rules; tenant isolation; human approval for consequential actions; provider adapters; compliance-ready feature gating rather than silent feature deletion.

Use the Gauntlet: `REQUIREMENT → PLAN → IMPLEMENT → VALIDATE → REVIEW → FIX → EVIDENCE → MERGE`. Do not silently expand scope or resolve material product/architecture contradictions. Escalate them through `OPEN_DECISIONS.md`/ADR workflow.

Once implementation exists, keep exact install/build/lint/typecheck/test/e2e commands current in this file so agents do not rediscover them each run.
